derivation:
by
  classical
  simpa only [PlaceSpecialization.fstDiv] using (Finsupp.filter_sum (p := P.IsStrictFst) s f)
explanation: Divisors are integer-valued finitely supported functions, and P.fstDiv is filtering by P.IsStrictFst. Thus the theorem specializes Finsupp.filter_sum to this predicate and these types. The current proof instead uses induction.
